claim_tested: AcrIF3 blocks Cas2/3 recruitment to the Csy complex
key_finding: AcrF3 binds Cas3 and prevents its recruitment to the DNA-bound Csy complex; Csy target binding is retained
context: P. aeruginosa PA14 type I-F, in vitro plasmid degradation and pull-down, phage infection
confidence_limits: High for the interaction; the format is steady-state with inhibitor present throughout, so it cannot order AcrIF3 binding relative to recruitment

claim_tested: AcrIF3 occludes the surface Cas2/3 uses for recruitment
key_finding: Crystal structure of the Cas3-AcrF3 complex (PDB 5B7I, 2.6 A) with ADP bound to Cas3
confidence_limits: High for the contact map; a single end-state structure carries no kinetic information and no binding constant is reported

claim_tested: AcrIF3 mimics Cas8f to capture Cas2/3
key_finding: Cryo-EM structure of the PaeCas3-AcrF3 complex (PDB 5GQH, 4.2 A), interpreted as Cas8f mimicry
confidence_limits: Moderate at 4.2 A; no nucleotide modelled; no affinity measured

claim_tested: Do the AcrIF3 and Csy footprints on Cas2/3 overlap sterically?
key_finding: 8 of the 18 Csy-contacting residues of a recruited Cas2/3 map inside the 58-residue AcrIF3 footprint; placing AcrIF3 on the recruited nuclease produces 1731-1833 heavy-atom pairs below 3.0 A against Csy2, Csy3 and the nucleic acid, minimum distance 0.32 A
context: PaCas3 5B7I superposed on ICP1 Cas2/3 in 8K22/8K24; NW alignment 31.8% identity over 887 positions
confidence_limits: The two associations are mutually exclusive, which is necessary but not sufficient for extraction; the Cas2/3-on-R-loop model is a different species and the depositions are unpublished

claim_tested: Is the ADP state a distinct conformer that a recruited Cas3 could not occupy?
key_finding: Across 16 independent copies spanning apo, ADP, AMPPNP and ATP, the RecA1-RecA2 hinge varies by 0.00-1.17 deg (sd 0.31) and the interlobe distance by 23.86-25.04 A (sd 0.26); nucleotide identity does not separate the states. The Cascade-recruited Cas3 differs by 3.11 deg and 22.52 A
context: T. fusca type I-E Cas3; the only Cas3 with a full nucleotide-state series
confidence_limits: The four nucleotide structures are isomorphous P2(1) crystals, so lattice restraint is a confounder; 6C66 is 3.66 A, where a 3 deg rotation sits at the edge of coordinate precision; type I-E, not I-F

claim_tested: What nucleotide does a recruited Cas2/3 carry?
key_finding: No deposited structure of a recruited or adaptation-engaged type I-F Cas2/3 (8K21-8K26, 8FLJ, 9P11, 9P1D) contains any modelled nucleotide; the same is true of the recruited type I-E Cas3 in 6C66
context: All 32 PDB entries containing a Cas3 or Cas2-3 polymer, queried 2026-11-26
confidence_limits: Absence from a model is not absence from the protein; it shows the quantity is unmeasured rather than measured as zero

claim_tested: When is acr expressed during infection?
key_finding: acr operons fire from a strong promoter immediately after DNA injection and are then shut down by Aca
context: P. aeruginosa phages, type I-F and I-E Acrs
confidence_limits: Measured for acr operons generally, not specifically for acrIF3 of JBD5

claim_tested: Can a single Acr phage genome overcome immunity?
key_finding: A single Acr phage fails; infection succeeds only once a threshold Acr dose accumulates, and the genomes that supply it are destroyed
context: P. aeruginosa PA14 type I-F, AcrIF1 and AcrIF4
confidence_limits: Different Acr proteins; the destruction of the first genomes is itself evidence that pre-recruited Cas2/3 is not reversed

claim_tested: Do Acr phages need to cooperate?
key_finding: CRISPR-immune bacteria remain partially immune to Acr phage; a first phage must suppress immunity so a second can replicate
confidence_limits: Indirect; consistent with but not proof of interception

stance: method precedent, not evidence on AcrIF3
claim_tested: Can Cas3 loading onto a licensed R-loop be watched in real time?
key_finding: Single-molecule DNA curtains resolve Cascade target binding and subsequent Cas3 recruitment and translocation
confidence_limits: The assay that would settle the order exists and has never been run with an anti-CRISPR added after R-loop formation
